## Review checklist

<!-- Check applicable items; explain any N/A items. See https://github.com/glaucia86/revelumo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] The change matches the issue or stated scope and avoids unrelated work.
- [ ] Behavior changes have a failing-then-passing test through agreed public interfaces, or I explained why behavior tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Relevant failure, interruption, reopening, and data-preservation cases are covered or their limits are recorded.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md records user-visible changes with a PR/issue reference, or I explained why an entry is not applicable. No incidental version bump, tag, or release is included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated; shared facts in the English, Portuguese, and Spanish READMEs agree where affected.
- [ ] Evidence uses synthetic or sanitized data and contains no personal photos, catalogs, secrets, personal paths, or private EXIF/GPS data.
- [ ] Third-party material has appropriate provenance, permission, and preserved license notices where applicable.
